title: DIVERGENCE disclosure record
description: LOCKED 6 August 2026. Every field traces to a decision in the step log. Do not add fields without recording why.

corpus_frozen_at.description: C34. The corpus is frozen at a stated moment. Changes go in the manifest changelog, never a silent update.

tax_year.description: C69. LOAD-BEARING. Both numbering systems are live: FY 2025-26 is governed by the 1961 Act, FY 2026-27 onwards by the 2025 Act. No provision may be cited without this.

facts.description: Node 1. Every field carries value, confidence and where it came from — never a bare value.

missing.description: Node 2, and it runs BEFORE any reasoning. Absence is established first and passed forward as a hard constraint.

blocks.description: Any conclusion in these regimes that depends on this item CANNOT be asserted. Enforced in code, not by prompt.

obtainable.description: An FIRC is 'not_for_this_route' — it is not that the user forgot it, it cannot exist here.

valuation.description: Node 3. Never one figure. The output is the range and its decomposition.

methods.description: D51: was minItems 2 ("a single method is a failure state") until C1/C5 needed to represent a case with NO genuine valuation dispute -- a determinate INR figure, not an incomplete lattice. A single method is a failure state ONLY when spread.inr is nonzero and only one was found; a single method with spread.inr == 0 is the false-abstention proof this project's own thesis needs: 'here there is exactly one defensible answer' has to be a representable output, not a schema violation.

mandated_by.description: The provision requiring this method, if any. Rule 115 mandates the SBI TT buying rate. The domestic market price is mandated by nothing — say so.

date_choice.description: R99 — THE GAP HAS A GAP. Where the mandated source did not publish on the settlement date, a second undetermined choice arises. Record it; never resolve it silently.

uncertainty_budget.description: C18, borrowed from metrology. Decompose the spread by contributing source. A bare total is hand-waving; a decomposition is engineering.

no_rate_published.description: TRUE where the mandated source published nothing for the settlement date. This is a feature of the output, not an error.

reasoning.description: D46 addendum, 20 Aug. Prompts 03/04 have always asked for this; the schema simply never allowed it (additionalProperties: false silently dropped it downstream, node_resolver.py's live D1 run caught it). Why this provision reaches these facts, or why it does not.

conditions.description: D46 addendum, 20 Aug. Prompt 04's cumulative-conditions test (IGST s.2(6)'s five conditions, taken one at a time) — same gap as reasoning above.

depends_on_missing.description: If non-empty, certainty is FORCED to insufficient_evidence by the gap constraint enforcer. Deterministic code, not a prompt instruction.

attacked.description: Node 5. R35 — everyone else uses critique to improve the answer before you see it. We publish the attack and downgrade the conclusion.

election.description: C65 — OPTIONAL BY DESIGN. A default is a recommendation, and we do not advise. The record is complete and valid with election = null.

both_shown.description: The material fact under s.439(8)(a). Always true — it is what the record exists to prove.

manifest.description: C20/C26. R37 — you earn the right to make a negative claim by declaring what you looked at. Shown to the user, not buried.

limits.description: Never empty. If this array is empty, the record is wrong.

_meta.description: D42/D44. Added 20 Aug — not part of the original 6 Aug lock. Which provider and models actually produced this record, so results.md can quote the file instead of the author's memory. Optional: absent on records written before this field existed.

llm.description: llm_call.provenance() at the moment this record was written — provider, the three resolved model ids, per-node token/retry counts, and the temperature actually used.

source_span.description: Where in the document this came from. Makes the extraction checkable.

models_agree.description: C49. Cross-model disagreement is a free Class 2 flag. It catches Class 3 badly — two models can agree and both be silently wrong.

certainty.description: C22. lacuna = no rule exists (Rule 57 and digital assets). open_texture = a rule exists but is vague (Hart, 1961). Different problems, different responses. inference = built from provisions read together, not stated explicitly — FEMA is ALWAYS inference, never settled.

observability.description: C17, borrowed from IFRS 13 / ASC 820. L1 = directly observed price. L2 = observable but indirect. L3 = unobservable, requiring disclosure of technique. Vocabulary any finance-literate reader already knows.

former_citation.description: Rule 57 was Rule 11UA. s.439 was s.270A. Dual form always.

verified.description: Set by the citation matcher — a deterministic string match against corpus text. FALSE means the conclusion is REJECTED, not flagged. Code, not a prompt instruction.
